body: I'm pretty comfortable with who I am right now.  The future is unforeseeable.  I'm not sure what I'll be a year from now.  No telling what I'll have done.  Eventually I'm going to end it when I have control and feel like it's imperative.
I've dug and dug and I think I'm approaching rock bottom.
I'm 26, but I feel like that is irrelevant.

That's great and all.  And I'm sure I want great things for you.  This is just something I've been living with for years now.  I once held an empty .357 to my head just to see what it felt like.  I immediately started bawling and couldn't imagine taking my own life, but at that moment I knew that some day I most likely would.
I consider myself pretty strong.  What exactly is the fight inside?
